text:
The constraints name only eight people, so I used "Eve" as a placeholder for the ninth, who has no constraints.

1. Ben comes right after Cara, and Cara is before Hana, so Ben is before Hana.
2. Gus comes right after Hana, and Ben and Gus are at least 3 apart. So Ben is at least 2 slots before Hana, and Cara at least 3 before Hana.
3. Ann, Dev and Cara are all before Ben, so Ben is in slot 4 or later. That puts Hana in slot 6 or later.
4. Finn is after Hana with exactly one person between them, so Finn is at Hana+2. Gus is at Hana+1, so Hana is at most slot 7.
5. If Hana is in slot 6, then Ben is 4, Cara is 3 and Ann is 1. Dev would need slot 3, which Cara holds, so this fails.
6. So Hana is 7, Gus is 8 and Finn is 9.
7. If Ben is in slot 4, the same clash over slot 3 appears, so Ben is 5 and Cara is 4.
8. Ann must be at least 3 before Ben, so Ann is in slot 1 or 2. Dev is exactly two slots from Ann. Ann in slot 2 would put Dev in slot 4, which Cara holds. So Ann is 1 and Dev is 3.
9. Ivo must be at least 3 from Hana, Ben and Finn, and before Gus. Only slot 2 satisfies all of these (slot 6 is too close to Hana), so Ivo is 2.
10. Eve takes the last free slot, 6.

I checked every constraint against this schedule and they all hold.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Ivo","3":"Dev","4":"Cara","5":"Ben","6":"Eve","7":"Hana","8":"Gus","9":"Finn"}
CONFIDENCE: 93
